headline: Revenue and profit surge on defense demand, backlog grows
summary_short: Leonardo DRS reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $913M (+10.1% y/y) and net earnings of $86M ($0.32 diluted EPS, +60.0% y/y), as gross margin expanded 220bp to 26.0% on favorable program mix and improved execution across both operating segments.
summary_long: Revenue rose 10.1% y/y to $913M on funded-backlog conversion and higher demand across both segments — IMS grew 14.8% on naval power and force protection; ASC grew 8.3% on tactical radar and counter-drone demand. Gross margin expanded 220bp to 26.0% on favorable mix and execution; G&A rose on IR&D and bid/proposal spend. Net earnings rose 59.3% to $86M ($0.32 diluted EPS) as the effective tax rate fell to 14.0% from 19.4%. Backlog reached $8.79B (+5.0% y/y). Cash fell to $270M from $647M after repaying a $191M term loan; the company paid a $0.09/share dividend and repurchased $12M of stock. Subsequent to quarter-end, DRS agreed to acquire Raft LLC for $450M (expected Q4 close).
